# GiProy BIM real IFC corpus

This directory contains unmodified public IFC reference models used to verify
the GiProy BIM parser and future Fragments viewer against non-synthetic data.

## License and attribution

The files are published by buildingSMART International under CC BY 4.0.
Source URLs, checksums and required attribution are recorded per file in
`manifest.json`.

The Duplex attribution required by its source is:

`BSI (2020), Duplex Apartment Test Files, buildingSMART International`.

No private project model belongs in this directory or in Git. Private pilot
models must remain in controlled local storage and use the same manifest
contract without exposing source content.

## Scale policy

`small`, `medium` and `large` are regression tiers relative to this corpus.
They do not replace the performance bands governed by `BIM-TASK-0088`.
